lyrics:
[Intro: church organ chords, heartbeat kick drum]

[Verse 1: female voice, breathy and low]
Closed for three years, lights off, sign turned round
I'd learned to live inside the quiet I had found
My sister says it's early, says be careful, says go slow
My friends all say they've seen this, and they know

[Pre-Chorus: strings enter, voice rising]
But something in me's knocking from within
And I am so tired of being safe

[Chorus: full, falsetto ringing, drums heavy]
I'm unguarded, I'm unguarded
I took the fence down with my hands
Let it hurt me, if it's going to
I would rather feel than stand
Behind a wall with nothing in it
I'm unguarded, gate wide open
Come in

[Verse 2: voice stronger, bass in]
He doesn't ask about the ring I wear on the other hand
He just leaves a little room, he seems to understand
There are days I talk to you, the one I buried, in the car
You'd have liked him. Or you'd tell me. I know just how you are.

[Pre-Chorus: strings, voice rising]
They keep saying guard your heart, protect it
I did. It didn't keep.

[Chorus: full, falsetto ringing, drums heavy]
I'm unguarded, I'm unguarded
I took the fence down with my hands
Let it hurt me, if it's going to
I would rather feel than stand
Behind a wall with nothing in it
I'm unguarded, gate wide open
Come in

[Bridge: organ and voice, building to a held note]
I know exactly what it costs
I have paid it
I'd pay it again

[Final Chorus: choir behind, voice at its highest]
I'm unguarded, I'm unguarded
I took the fence down with my hands
Let it hurt me, if it's going to
I would rather feel than stand
Behind a wall with nothing in it
I'm unguarded, gate wide open
Come in

[Outro: heartbeat drum alone, slowing, a gate latch]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 52 BPM with a double-time heartbeat pulse, 4/4, F major. Slow, steady and swelling.

VOICE: Female, wide-ranging and agile. She sings the verses in a breathy low register, climbs through the pre-chorus and rings out in a strong falsetto and head voice in the choruses, with runs. A choir supports the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A church organ, a deep kick drum playing a heartbeat pattern, a marching snare, strings, a sustained bass, wooden percussion, a choir, acoustic guitar picking.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, organ and heartbeat. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:50 Pre-chorus. 1:02 Chorus 1. 1:40 Verse 2. 2:16 Pre-chorus. 2:28 Chorus 2. 3:04 Bridge. 3:22 Final chorus. 3:50 Outro, heartbeat and a latch, ends 3:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2000s pop-soul ballad: warm organ, thudding drums up front, vocal clear and soaring.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'They keep saying guard your heart. I did. It didn't keep.' at 2:16.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original defends a first great love against doubters. This defends a second one, by a woman who knows precisely what the risk is because she has already paid it.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Shut, stirring, defiant, open.
